policy.note: OpenCode stats exposes tokens/sessions but not reliable per-run billing. Conservative call/time/file limits are enforced instead. If a paid model is selected, stop and request an approved spend budget.

escalation.onApprovalGate: Stop, record the exact action and options, and request human approval.
escalation.onBlocker: Record the blocker, preserve the tree, and produce a resumable report.
escalation.onValidationFailure: Attempt up to 3 root-cause repairs, then mark blocked.
escalation.onBudgetExhaustion: Stop starting new tasks, save state, and report remaining work.
escalation.onInterruption: Inspect Git and partial output before resuming; never blindly replay.
